question: The Republic Day Parade in India is presided over by the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**President of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Republic Day Parade in India is presided over by the **President of India**, the ceremonial head of state.
 
• The President arrives at Rajpath in New Delhi, where the parade is held, and unfurls the national flag.
 
• This event marks the celebration of India becoming a republic on January 26, 1950.
 
• Republic Day is a national holiday in India and is celebrated with grandeur, including military parades, cultural performances, and the presentation of bravery awards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Significance of Republic Day**

 
 
• Republic Day commemorates the day the Constitution of India came into effect, replacing the Government of India Act (1935) as the governing document.
 
• The Constitution establishes India as a republic, with a democratic system of government.
 
 
 
• **Republic Day Parade**
 
 
• The parade showcases India's defense capability, cultural heritage, and social progress.
 
• It involves various regiments of the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force marching in all their finery and official decorations.
 
• Tableaux from different states and ministries depict the diversity and richness of India's culture.
 
 
 
• **Bravery Awards**
 
 
• The President of India presents various awards, including the Ashoka Chakra and Kirti Chakra, to military personnel and civilians for their acts of bravery.
 
• Children who have performed outstanding acts of bravery are also honored with the National Bravery Award.
 
 
 
• **Beating Retreat Ceremony**
 
 
• The celebrations conclude with the Beating Retreat Ceremony on January 29, held at Vijay Chowk.
 
• The ceremony features performances by bands of the Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force.
 
• It marks the official end of the Republic Day festivities.
